sh_1.speaker: Narration
sh_1.text: A backlog stacked by the register and a closing time that won't budge. The clock on the wall is loud today.

sh_prep.speaker: Narration
sh_prep.text: There's a way to do this without burning out — or a way to just sprint it. Which?

choices.text: Pace the work — steady hands beat frantic ones.
Sprint it — clear the lot before close, whatever it takes.

sh_into.speaker: Narration
sh_into.text: The deadline presses in from every side. Who can lock in and carry the shift?

sh_strong.speaker: Rowan
sh_strong.text: He drops into the work like a gear clicking home — task after task, the backlog melting away with time to spare.

sh_ok.speaker: Iris
sh_ok.text: Calm and even, she keeps it moving. Not fast, but nothing slips.

sh_strain.speaker: June
sh_strain.text: She means well, but the ticking clock isn't kind to her — it's a scramble to the finish.

sh_done.speaker: Narration
sh_done.text: The shutters come down. The counter's clear. Made it.
